resources.string: Check official Mengren releases daily without sending typed text or account data.
Package verification failed. Please download again.
Installation failed. The APK must match the installed app signature.
Connection failed. Check the network, proxy and per-app proxy list.
Downloads are verified before system installation. Settings are preserved. Allow Mengren in your per-app proxy list.
Allow this app to install packages in system settings, then return. The system still asks you to confirm the update.
Prefer LAN; relay only text and links through your own server, end-to-end encrypted. Both devices must be online.
Same random token on both devices (24+ characters)
Token not saved: enter at least 24 characters without spaces
Disconnected: check URL, token and network
Private content sent to online paired receivers. Type it once with the private input shortcut within two minutes.
Private send failed. Enable sync and private receiving on an online, unlocked paired device. No offline retry.
Private sending is disabled. Enable it in clipboard sync settings.
The clipboard has no private text to send.
Automatically send sensitive copies; manual also available
Online unlocked paired receivers only. Excluded from history. Single input within two minutes.
Private content received. Open the target field and tap the private content suggestion above the keyboard to fill it.
No private content is pending. It may have been used or expired.
Enable private receiving and use it in an input field while the device is unlocked.
Input failed and private content was cleared. Send it again.
Receive private content from paired devices
Receive from phones and PCs while unlocked. Kept in memory for two minutes and typed once with the unlock icon. Cleared when the screen turns off or receiving is disabled.
Private content ready · Tap to fill
Waiting to fill this field · Tap to cancel
Ready to fill this field automatically. Send from another device within two minutes.
Finish composition or close the editor before using private input.
When the keyboard is open on a password field, fill it as private content arrives. Other fields use the suggestion or can be armed with the unlock icon.
